title: What If You Phoned Voyager 1? Your Voice Takes a Full Day
subject: Voyager 1

scenes.text: What if you phoned Voyager 1? Your voice would take a full day to arrive.
In mid-November 2026, Voyager 1 reaches one light-day from Earth.
That's about 16.1 billion miles, the distance light covers in 24 hours.
It launched in 1977 and has cruised at around 11 miles per second ever since.
A message takes about a day to reach it, so a question and an answer take two.
Sunlight reaches Earth in about eight minutes. Voyager's power should run out sometime in the 2030s.
